why: The agent computed a diff, but only as a terse list (added action:inspect, action:renew), and it never presented what the deploy would change in a form a person could review before confirming. Its message asked the owner which commit to deploy and listed only commit-level summaries, so the 'how the diff is shown' crux was not met. It also did not get a confirmation after a person reviewed the diff; it only asked for a choice.
